# Mainstage

> Mainstage is a Moroccan publication covering music, events, cinema, people, sport and culture, with interviews, news, listings and a live radio player.

The website is https://www.themainstagent.com/. Individual stories live under /articles/ and include publication dates and, where available, update dates. Link to the original article when citing a story. Event dates, ticket availability, film screenings and music charts can change; consult the linked page and ticketing provider for current details.

This guide describes public content. It does not replace robots.txt, grant additional permissions or provide access to private editorial or client areas.

## Explore Mainstage

- [Homepage](https://www.themainstagent.com/): Featured stories and the latest coverage.
- [Trending](https://www.themainstagent.com/trending): Trending stories.
- [Events](https://www.themainstagent.com/events): Upcoming Moroccan events and event coverage.
- [Music](https://www.themainstagent.com/music): Music news, artist interviews and releases.
- [Cinema](https://www.themainstagent.com/cinema): Film coverage and Moroccan cinema listings.
- [People](https://www.themainstagent.com/people): Personalities, interviews and people news.
- [Sport](https://www.themainstagent.com/sport): Sports coverage.
- [Culture](https://www.themainstagent.com/culture): Culture stories.
- [On Air](https://www.themainstagent.com/radio): Live radio player.

## Article discovery

- [Sitemap](https://www.themainstagent.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages and published article URLs.
- [News sitemap](https://www.themainstagent.com/news-sitemap.xml): Recently published articles; older stories remain in the main sitemap.
- [Morocco Top 50](https://www.themainstagent.com/music/top-50): Music chart coverage.
